decisive_spans.text: Child-Pugh grade C (13 points) end-stage liver failure
Massive pleural effusion in the right lower lung lobe

response.rationale: The patient's Child-Pugh grade C end-stage liver failure and massive pleural effusion strongly support Hepatohydraulic Syndrome. While Spontaneous Bacterial Empyema is also supported by the pleural effusion and reduced breath sounds, the specific mention of end-stage liver failure makes Hepatohydraulic Syndrome a more direct and encompassing diagnosis for the pleural effusion in this context.
